module_summary: Two-state Moore FSM with async reset to B: in=0 toggles state, in=1 holds; out high in state B.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 1-bit A/B state register toggled when in is 0; decodes out.

anchors.name: out
anchors.why: Moore output decoded high in state B.

groups.name: fsm
groups.description: Next-state logic on in, state register and Moore output decode.
